Urban.description: Thriving in bustling cities and crowded markets with clever social tricks.

features.name: Urban Tanuki
features.tldr: You gain bonuses to deception and gathering local street rumors.

Wildwood.description: Deeply attuned to dense forests and secluded rural countrysides.

features.name: Wildwood Tanuki
features.tldr: You gain bonuses to survival skills and tracking in natural environments.
